news.title: Carrick and Fernandes hold clear-the-air talks
news.description: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick and captain Bruno Fernandes hold clear-the-air talks at the club's training ground.

news.title: 'Relax, I love Kane and Lamine Yamal' - Henry defends his Ballon d'Or hosting
news.description: Former Arsenal forward Thierry Henry responds to criticism of a number of comments he made during Monday's Ballon d'Or ceremony and claims they were "jokes".

news.title: All Spanish cup matches suspended after Madrid train collision
news.description: All 24 matches in the Spanish Copa del Rey due to take place on Wednesday are suspended as a mark of respect after more than 30 people were killed in a train crash near Madrid.

news.title: Arsenal to appeal against Dowman red card
news.description: Arsenal will appeal against Max Dowman's sending-off during Tuesday's Carabao Cup defeat at Fleetwood Town.

news.title: Liverpool gambled on Jacquet and it is paying off
news.description: Liverpool beat Chelsea to the signing of Jeremy Jacquet and the defender is thriving at Anfield. Things could have been very different...

news.title: McClean leaves Derry City after contract dispute
news.description: James McClean says Derry City "will always hold a special place in my heart" after mutually agreeing to terminate his contract with immediate effect.

news.title: Can clubs stop team news leaking out through FPL picks?
news.description: Chelsea striker Joao Pedro's injury was leaked through the Fantasy Premier League game, but is there anything clubs can do?

news.title: Dowman sees red as Arsenal dumped out, but did Arteta go too far?
news.description: A shocking defeat, a red card card, a penalty-shootout and a drone tell the story of Arsenal's dramatic loss to League Two Fleetwood Town in the last-16 of the Carabao Cup.
